# Valid Palindrome II.

@example Taking out the o leaves "stats", which is a palindrome.
"stoats"
=> true

@example None of "omato", "tmato", "toato", "tomto", "tomao" and "tomat" is a palindrome, and neither is "tomato".
"tomato"
=> false

@example It is a palindrome already, so nothing needs to be taken out.
"noon"
=> true

# A single letter.
"q"
=> true

# Three different letters: no deletion helps.
"xyz"
=> false

# Only deleting the first letter works, and only deleting the last.
"wrotor"
=> true

"rotorw"
=> true

# At the first mismatch (m against o), each letter equals the other one's
# neighbour, but only one deletion works: the left one here, the right one
# in the second case.
"momtmo"
=> true

"omtmom"
=> true

# The same shape, where neither deletion works.
"gunhgu"
=> false

# Two stray letters need two deletions.
"rxefeyr"
=> false

# After deleting the z, the next pair matches but a later one does not.
"zmnopnm"
=> false

# The same, with six matching pairs after the z before one fails.
"zmnopqrstrqponm"
=> false

# Deleting the y fixes every one of the many pairs that differ.
"yrotator"
=> true

# Either e of the run can go.
"reeviver"
=> true

# 4100 letters: all a, but two b's around the middle, too far apart for one
# deletion to fix.
""
=> false

# Random small cases from gen.c (lc check --regen makes them): odd seeds
# make false cases, even seeds true ones.
@gen 1 small
"prqpqqqp"
=> false

@gen 2 small
"qpppppp"
=> true

@gen 3 small
"pppqqqqppq"
=> false

@gen 4 small
"qppq"
=> true

@gen 5 small
"qppppppqqp"
=> false

@gen 6 small
"qr"
=> true

@gen 7 small
"qqqpp"
=> false

@gen 8 small
"qq"
=> true

@gen 9 small
"qrrqppq"
=> false

@gen 10 small
"pppr"
=> true
